title: Settings
folderAdded: Folder added: its projects come in at the next scan.
folderRemoved: Folder removed: its songs leave the app.
already: This folder is already in the list.

folders.projectsHint: The folders that hold your Ableton projects, subfolders included.
folders.samplesHint: Where to look for a sample a project can no longer find, on top of the projects folders and Ableton's library.
folders.midiHint: The MIDI files in your projects and samples folders are already read. Add other folders here (construction kits, packs): the app only reads the MIDI files in them.
folders.oldWindowsHint: An old Windows on another drive (dual boot): its plugins and samples help repair old projects.
folders.oldDriveSaved: Saved: used from the next scan.

arrange.sub: How the app arranges your songs.
arrange.physicalHint: Off, everything is arranged in the app only (releases, mood boards, folders): no file moves on your disk, Ctrl+Z included. On, you can also move and create folders, and put a release in its own folder. Every move is checked (a project that would lose a sample stays put) and can be undone with Ctrl+Z, after confirming.
arrange.physicalOn: On: the app can move files when you ask.
arrange.physicalOnSaid: Physical arranging on: files can be moved.
arrange.physicalOffSaid: Physical arranging off: nothing moves on disk any more.
arrange.artistsHint: One name per line. A song in a folder carrying one of these names belongs to that artist.
arrange.artistsSaved: Artists saved: the songs are arranged again.
arrange.wordsHint: Words you put in the name of a working copy ("test", "try"...): a file carrying them stays a version of the same song. One per line.
arrange.wordsSaved: Saved: the songs are arranged again.
arrange.artistsMoved: Who is you, who is a guest, which names are the same: it is all set on the Artists page.

data.sub: Scanning your projects, and what goes in or out of the app.
data.scanHint: The app rereads your projects as soon as they change, and at least every minute. "Reread everything" is only needed after an update of the app or of Live.
data.noLive: Live hasn't been opened on this computer yet: its plugin list is missing.
data.exportHint: Your songs in a CSV file for a spreadsheet (Excel, Google Sheets) or another tool: title, artist, style, key, tempo, stage, rating, catalogue, plugin status, reference render, dates, folder. You choose where to save it; nothing else is written.
data.notionHint: Export your Notion database as CSV (the database's ••• menu, Export, "Markdown & CSV"), then choose the file. You check which column goes where before anything is written, and Ctrl+Z undoes the import.
data.notionDialog: CSV export of the Notion database
data.autoHint: Spool reads a project again as soon as you save it, finds the new renders, audio files, samples and MIDI, and analyses their sounds in the background. While Live is open, the sound analysis slows down by itself so as not to disturb it. Off, nothing runs without you: an "Analyse" button appears at the bottom of the sidebar.
data.autoOff: Off: the analysis runs with the sidebar's "Analyse" button.
data.autoOffSaid: Automatic analysis off: the "Analyse" button is at the bottom of the sidebar

spool.sub: The installed version and its updates.
spool.updatesHint: Spool checks for a newer version shortly after it starts, then every 6 hours. Nothing installs without your click, never during a scan or a repair, and only a version signed by Fatstep is accepted. Your database is copied before any update that changes it.

zero.hint: Empties the app's database: songs, stages, styles, notes, groupings, folders, artists, processing presets and repair history, then reopens the setup. Your projects, your samples and the copies already written are not touched. The old database is set aside (the last 2 are kept).
zero.confirm: Everything you arranged in the app will be removed. Continue?

fatstep.title: Publisher
fatstep.body: Spool is free and open source, made by Fatstep, a label and distributor for independent artists. When your songs are ready, we can help you release them.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.hint: Light or dark, or as Windows is set.

audio.title: Audio analysis
audio.hint: Listens to your renders to find the songs that sound alike, confirm their tempo and key and recognise their style. On by default: Spool downloads about {mb} MB, once and in the background: the CLAP audio model (from Spool's page on GitHub) and Microsoft's ONNX Runtime, each file checked before use. You can turn it off here at any time.
audio.privacy: The analysis runs on this computer only: nothing about your music is sent anywhere. It works in the background, one render at a time, and waits while a scan or a repair runs.
audio.credit: Model: LAION's CLAP larger_clap_general (laion.ai), Apache-2.0 licence. Engine: Microsoft's ONNX Runtime, MIT licence.
audio.disable: Turn off (the analyses already made are kept)

paused.one: Paused. {n} reference render analysed out of {total}
paused.other: Paused. {n} reference renders analysed out of {total}

audio.kept: Turned off. The model is still on disk ({mb} MB).
audio.removeHint: Deletes the downloaded files to free the disk. What was already analysed stays.
audio.downloadStarted: Audio analysis on: downloading the model
audio.notice: Spool is downloading its audio analysis model (about {mb} MB, once). Nothing of your music leaves this computer. Settings > Spool to turn it off.
audio.samplesTodo: Unsorted samples to listen to: {n}. Time: {time} on this computer, in the background; about {size} in the base.
audio.samplesDone: {n} unsorted samples were sorted by ear.

storage.title: Storage
storage.hint: What Spool keeps on this computer, in its own folder. Your projects are not in it: they are neither counted nor touched here. Do not change anything in it by hand while Spool is open.
storage.midi: {size} for the index of your MIDI files
storage.backupsHint: Made before a Spool update that changes the format, or when you start over. Only the newest is kept, compressed (.gz); one made before an update is deleted after 30 days.
storage.cache: Thumbnails, audio previews, playable copies and small files: {size}
storage.trimConfirm: Delete the safety copies except the newest one? Your catalogue and your projects do not change.
storage.journal: {size} of journal, emptied at the next start
storage.samples: {size} for the index of your samples
storage.modelHint: It listens to your reference renders and samples, on this computer only. Settings > Spool > Audio analysis to remove it.
storage.webviewHint: Managed by Windows' display engine (WebView2), beside Spool's folder.
storage.cacheHint: The AIFF files you listen to are converted once to WAV to be played here; a copy not played again for two weeks is deleted.

merge.title: Merge two artists
merge.hint: When one artist has two names ("MosMarni" and "Mos Marni"). The songs, the releases and the folders' artist take the name kept, and the next scans read the old name as the new one. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
merge.folders: To tidy the folders on disk as well: Songs > Folders > Reorganise proposes the moves, one by one, doing nothing until you confirm.

keyboard.title: MIDI keyboard
keyboard.hint: A keyboard plugged into the computer plays the sound chosen (piano, organ, synth, bass...), with its own volume, to try ideas over a song. It can also be set up from the keyboard icon at the top right.
keyboard.unsupported: This computer gives no access to MIDI keyboards.
keyboard.none: No MIDI keyboard found: plug one in, it shows up here.

feat.title: Featured artists
feat.hint: A name taken for one of your artists that is a featured artist: its songs go back to the main artist, with this name in their featurings. It leaves your artists list.
feat.name: Featured name
feat.wasRoot: {name} featured, songs to the folder's artist

telemetry.title: Share errors and usage statistics
telemetry.hint: Errors and anonymous usage statistics (the pages and tools used, Spool's version and your system), to fix bugs and improve the app. Your projects, songs and file names are never sent, and no account is needed.
telemetry.on: On: shared under a random identifier.
telemetry.off: Off: nothing is sent, and the random identifier is deleted.
telemetry.onSaid: Thanks: errors and usage statistics are shared

tabs.title: Song tabs
tabs.hint: Each song opened keeps its tab, to the right of the list. Without tabs, a song opened takes the place of the one shown.
tabs.off: Off: one song at a time
